ctx.summary: Garuda asks about the illnesses of the mind. Kakbhushundi: delusion is the root of them all. Desire is wind, greed is phlegm, anger is bile that burns the chest, and when the three combine the fever is grave. 'Mine' is ringworm, envy an itch, burning at another's joy a wasting disease, ego a swelling, craving dropsy. Everyone has them; few notice. The cure: a true teacher as physician and trust in his word, restraint as the diet, devotion to Rama as the herb, taken with faith. The sign of recovery is that dispassion gains strength, good sense gains appetite, and the weakness of craving goes.
